output.summary: The commit adds a rounding test for formatPrice and changes build and test configuration: Node 22 in CI, coverage in the test script with a version bump, and a stricter TypeScript option. The changes are independent of each other; the user gave no requirement to check against.

groups.title: formatPrice gains a half-up rounding test
groups.description: Adds a test that formatPrice(0.125) returns '0.13'. Check that the expectation matches the intended rounding and is not sensitive to floating-point representation.

groups.title: Test script, version and compiler strictness
groups.description: package.json bumps the version to 1.0.1 and runs vitest with --coverage, and tsconfig.json enables noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Check that the coverage provider is installed and that the stricter option does not break existing code.

groups.title: CI moves to Node 22
groups.description: The workflow's Node version goes from 20 to 22. This looks unrelated to the other edits; check that the project supports Node 22.
